threat_level, analysis,
has_threat_tags, admiralty,
list[AttributeData]

span.p:
Severity= min(1.0, map_value(threat_level) × tags_multiplier)
tags_multiplier = 1.0 + 0.5 × (1 if tags_present,0 if not)

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C_sightings
= max(0, 2×(TP+1)/(TP+FP+2) − 1)
TP = positive sightings
FP = false-positive sightings

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C_admiralty
= Sqr(reliability_value × credibility_value)
absent Admiralty tag → value = 0.0

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
C_evidence
= 1 − ∏(1 − Att_confidence_i)
for all computed Att_confidence values

span.p:
Final Score
= 1 − ∏(1 − Score_event_i)
for all computed Score_event values
